summary.text: Leader of the Danaans whom Hector slew when Zeus vouchsafed the prince glory — no homonym in the atlas.

story.text: Among the leaders of the Danaans staunch in fight, Hector smote Aesymnus together with Asaeus, Autonous, Opites, Dolops son of Clytius, Opheltius, Agelaus, Orus, and Hipponous, and thereafter fell upon the multitude.
